structured.reason: With the guard removed, a descriptor-only tool (callable None) is still invoked. The resulting TypeError is then wrapped as a ToolExecutionError, which looks like a runtime failure of the tool. The original instead rejects the call up front with a ValueError saying the tool is descriptor-only. TREQ_TOOL_REGISTRY requires registered tools to be executed consistently, so this difference matters.
structured.test_focus: Register a descriptor-only tool (no callable) and execute a ToolCall for it. Check that execute raises ValueError naming the tool as descriptor-only, and that it does not raise ToolExecutionError.
